whatThisRecordIs: An IMMUTABLE governance record of the owner's interpretation of the SET_R primary order that frozen Methodology V2 R3 names but does not define: how the two persisted per-track candidate scores of ONE source page-evidence row become ONE page-level SET_R score. It adds an interpretation; it changes no frozen methodology byte, no plan byte, no earlier record, no signal rule and no evidence.

theGapAcknowledged.frozenR3SetRText: SET_R: from the same deduplicated pool, take the first SET_R_MAX_PAGES_PER_ORGANISATION = 4 by the FROZEN deterministic Track A/B signal score descending, tie-broken by sha256("SET_R_V2_R2:" + documentSha256) ascending.

theGapAcknowledged.statement: MAX is an explicit owner clarification of an undefined reduction. It is NOT claimed to be what R3 already said.

ownerDecision.trackAScore: the persisted candidate_score of the row's INTERNATIONAL_OFFICE observation under orgunit-signal-rules-v1
ownerDecision.trackBScore: the persisted candidate_score of the row's LANGUAGE_CENTRE observation under orgunit-signal-rules-v1

ownerDecision.signedScoreStatement: Scores stay signed: max(-2, -4) = -2, never 0. The signed persisted ordering is meaningful.

decimalSemantics.statement: MAX selects one already-persisted observation. No addition, averaging, rounding, rescaling or widened synthetic score domain is required. The selected value is exactly value-equivalent to the winning persisted candidate_score.
decimalSemantics.textualSerializationNote: Current authority does not guarantee one exact driver serialization of numeric(8,4). A future implementation may canonicalise or validate the decimal representation mechanically but may not alter the numeric value.

requiredTrackEvidence.resolvableOnlyWhen: exactly one INTERNATIONAL_OFFICE observation AND exactly one LANGUAGE_CENTRE observation, both under orgunit-signal-rules-v1

ownerDecision.rankWithinRootStatement: rank_within_root is a position within (run, root, track, rule_version). It participates in NEITHER the K1 reduction NOR the SET_R primary order NOR the SET_R secondary order.

whatThisDoesNotChange.statement: Every value in this object is false in the sense of 'this decision changed or authorised it'. The SET_R_V2_R2: salt, the cap of 4, orgunit-signal-rules-v1 and every persisted candidate_score are untouched.

it does not change K3 or the short-text membership policy

it does not grant any network, database, sealed-filesystem or reserve authority

immutability.thisRecordIsNeverEdited: A correction is a NEW record that references this one by SHA-256. This file is never rewritten, re-hashed or re-statused.
